verdict: Working every independent NYC cardiology practice once yields about 27 first conversations; adding hospital-system sites, a 90-day recycle and referrals brings the whole market to about 56. That is 0.7 months of a 75/month target. Hitting 75 every month needs about 789 fresh accounts a month at the blended rate, so the same engine has to widen: cardiometabolic-adjacent specialties in NYC (endocrinology, nephrology), then metro cardiology (Long Island, Westchester, North Jersey).
